# .NET 11 and Python 3.15 are generally available, and Node.js 26 LTS is now on Azure App Service

## What Changed

.NET 11 and Python 3.15 are now generally available on Azure App Service for Linux, alongside Node.js 26 Long Term Support (LTS). You can use these runtimes for production applications, whether you’re creating a new app or upgrading an existing workload.

## Why It Matters to a CSA

A generally available capability may remove a blocker or create an expansion opportunity.

## Customer Impact

**Medium**. Lifecycle: `ga`. Change type: `new`.

## Recommended Action

Confirm regional availability and evaluate it against active customer architectures.
